title: Savvy Games Group to acquire Moonton Games for $6 billion
content: Saudi Arabia's Savvy Games Group, a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), has agreed to acquire Shanghai-based Moonton Technology from ByteDance for over $6 billion. The deal was confirmed on March 20, 2026. Moonton is the developer behind Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, one of the most popular mobile games in Southeast Asia. ByteDance originally acquired Moonton in 2021 for $4 billion. The acquisition ranks among the six largest video game deals ever made.
